response.sql: WITH filtered_scans AS (SELECT s.zoneref, s.gbsize, s.spanmin FROM scans s WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND s.zoneref IS NOT NULL), group_stats AS (SELECT fs.zoneref, si.healtheval, COUNT(*) as scan_count, AVG(CASE WHEN fs.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND fs.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND fs.spanmin > 0 THEN fs.gbsize / fs.spanmin ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio FROM filtered_scans fs JOIN sites si ON fs.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY fs.zoneref, si.healtheval), mean_calculation AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_mean FROM group_stats WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL), filtered_result AS (SELECT gs.zoneref, gs.healtheval, gs.avg_ratio, gs.scan_count, gs.avg_ratio - mc.overall_mean as beat_amount FROM group_stats gs CROSS JOIN mean_calculation mc WHERE mc.overall_mean IS NOT NULL AND gs.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND gs.avg_ratio > mc.overall_mean) SELECT zoneref, healtheval, avg_ratio, scan_count, beat_amount FROM filtered_result ORDER BY CASE WHEN beat_amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, beat_amount DESC LIMIT 10
